# Step 2: methods

```{r step2-setup}
source("R/setup.R"); source("R/analysis.R"); source("R/results.R")
source("R/spatial_nulls.R"); source("R/extensions.R")
res_k <- setNames(resolutions, resolutions)
D <- lapply(res_k, prep_resolution)
CC <- lapply(res_k, load_caches)
d4 <- D[["400"]]; c4 <- CC[["400"]]
syn <- colnames(d4$A)
primary <- c("AD", "bvFTD", "svPPA", "nfvPPA")
syn_lab <- function(x) factor(x, levels = syn)
fmt_p <- function(p) ifelse(is.na(p), "", ifelse(p < 0.001, "<0.001", sprintf("%.3f", p)))
```

**Inputs.** Atrophy a_i = −mean t per parcel (Section 4), seven maps. HCP SC with its
`r paste(sapply(D, "[[", "n_negative_sc"), collapse = "/")` negative edges (100/200/400
parcels) set to 0; FC used as given (all entries ≥ 0). Euclidean distances between CBIG
parcel centroids (MNI mm). Schaefer-400 is primary; 100 and 200 repeat everything.

**connectomeR.** The package tarball was not available. Following your instruction to go
on, every function the analysis needs was written in this project and validated
before use (Section 6.1): communication models in `R/communication.R` (+ C++ kernels in
`src/netcpp.cpp`), spin permutations and rewiring in `R/nulls.R`, all with roxygen
headers and testthat tests (`tests/testthat/`, 35 expectations, all passing), written
so they can move into connectomeR as `R/communication.R` for version 0.3.0. The 0.3.0
package build and `R CMD check` could not be done without the 0.2.0 source.

**Prediction rule.** For a model matrix M, P_i = Σ_{j≠i} M_ij a_j / Σ_{j≠i} M_ij and the
statistic is r(a, P). With M = SC (or FC) this is the neighbour atrophy N_i of
Zeighami et al. (2015) and Shafiei et al. (2023).

**Models on the SC.** Shortest-path efficiency (1/weighted path length, lengths 1/w);
weighted communicability expm(S^-1/2 W S^-1/2) (Crofts & Higham 2009); search
information (Goñi et al. 2014), used as the shortest-path probability 2^−SI; navigation
efficiency with Euclidean greedy routing (Seguin et al. 2018); diffusion efficiency
1/MFPT (Goñi et al. 2013). Asymmetric measures were symmetrised as (M + Mᵀ)/2. Two
models with one fitted parameter: the distance-only kernel exp(−d/λ) (λ over 40 values,
2–200 mm), and, added here, the network diffusion (heat) kernel expm(−βL) of Raj et al.
(2012), with L the normalised Laplacian of the SC (β over 25 values). Fitted parameters
were chosen to maximise r and **refitted inside every null surrogate and every rewired
network**, so the nulls account for the fitting.

**Nulls (1,000 each).** (1) Spin: Hungarian-reassigned rotations of fsaverage5 parcel
centroids (Vasa/Markello method), atrophy permuted, all predictions recomputed.
(2) Degree-preserving rewiring of the SC (Maslov–Sneppen, 10 swaps per edge, weights
travel with edges), all models recomputed on each rewired network, atrophy unchanged.
Extensions add (3) geometry-preserving rewiring, (4) variogram-matched surrogates and
(5) Moran spectral randomisation. p-values are one-sided (null r ≥ observed r) for model
fits and two-sided for paired differences. FDR (Benjamini–Hochberg) is applied across
syndromes × models within each null.

## Validation of the new functions

```{r validation}
val <- read.csv("output/validation/communication_validation.csv")
val[, c("quantity", "reference", "max_abs_diff", "max_rel_diff", "offdiag_nonfinite_pattern_identical")]
spv <- read.csv("output/validation/spin_validation.csv")
data.frame(check = c("spin p-values, R vs neuromaps (21 map pairs): max |difference|",
                     "spin p-values: correlation", "null SD ratio R / neuromaps (range)",
                     "KS test of null distributions: min p"),
           value = c(sprintf("%.3f", max(abs(spv$p_spin_R - spv$p_spin_neuromaps))),
                     sprintf("%.4f", cor(spv$p_spin_R, spv$p_spin_neuromaps)),
                     sprintf("%.2f-%.2f", min(spv$null_sd_R / spv$null_sd_neuromaps), max(spv$null_sd_R / spv$null_sd_neuromaps)),
                     sprintf("%.2f", min(spv$ks_p_null))))
rw <- read.csv("output/validation/rewiring_validation.csv")
aggregate(cbind(edge_turnover, mean_edge_length, ks_D_edge_length, weight_length_rho, interhemispheric_edges) ~ null, rw, function(v) round(mean(v), 3))
```

Every communication model matches bctpy 0.6.1 or netneurotools 0.3.0 on the Schaefer-400
SC to floating-point precision. Two notes: bctpy's `search_information` fails under
NumPy 2, so the reference keeps bctpy's own Floyd–Warshall and path retrieval and only
flattens the returned path; navigation agrees exactly, including which pairs fail
(`r sprintf("%.1f%%", 100 * c4$nav_success)` of pairs succeed at 400 parcels). Spins
match neuromaps' Hungarian implementation in distribution. Degree-preserving rewiring
moves 92% of edges and doubles the mean edge length; geometry-preserving rewiring keeps
edge lengths and the weight–length relation but saturates at about 50% turnover.

# A. Similarity between syndromes

```{r A-similarity, fig.width = 6.2, fig.height = 5.2}
simA <- analysis_similarity(d4, c4$perms)
sur_v <- readRDS("output/cache/surrogates_variogram_k400.rds"); names(sur_v) <- syn
sur_m <- readRDS("output/cache/surrogates_moran_k400.rds"); names(sur_m) <- syn
simA$p_variogram <- mapply(function(a, b) p_two(cor(d4$A[, a], d4$A[, b]), colcor(sur_v[[a]], matrix(d4$A[, b], 400, ncol(sur_v[[a]])))), simA$map1, simA$map2)
simA$p_moran <- mapply(function(a, b) p_two(cor(d4$A[, a], d4$A[, b]), colcor(sur_m[[a]], matrix(d4$A[, b], 400, ncol(sur_m[[a]])))), simA$map1, simA$map2)
simA$q_variogram <- p.adjust(simA$p_variogram, "BH")
simA %>% mutate(across(where(is.numeric), ~ round(.x, 3)))
Rm <- cor(d4$A)
Rl <- as.data.frame(as.table(Rm)) %>% setNames(c("a", "b", "r")) %>%
  left_join(bind_rows(simA %>% select(a = map1, b = map2, q = p_fdr), simA %>% select(a = map2, b = map1, q = p_fdr)), by = c("a", "b")) %>%
  mutate(lab = ifelse(a == b, "", paste0(sprintf("%.2f", r), ifelse(!is.na(q) & q < 0.05, "*", ""))),
         a = factor(a, syn), b = factor(b, rev(syn)))
ggplot(Rl, aes(a, b, fill = r)) +
  geom_tile(colour = "#fcfcfb", linewidth = 1) +
  geom_text(aes(label = lab), size = 3.1, colour = "#0b0b0b") +
  scale_fill_gradient2(low = pal_div[["low"]], mid = pal_div[["mid"]], high = pal_div[["high"]], midpoint = 0, limits = c(-1, 1), name = "Pearson r") +
  labs(x = NULL, y = NULL, subtitle = "Schaefer-400; * spin-test FDR q < 0.05") +
  coord_equal() + theme(panel.grid = element_blank())
```

# C. Network-constrained atrophy: SC vs FC

```{r C-neighbour}
mt4 <- model_table(c4)
C_tab <- mt4 %>% filter(R == 0, model %in% c("SC_direct", "FC")) %>%
  select(syndrome, model, r, p_spin, q_spin, p_rew_deg, q_rew_deg, p_rew_geo, p_variogram, p_moran)
dSF <- difference_table(c4, ref = "FC", models = "SC_direct") %>% filter(R == 0) %>%
  select(syndrome, r_SC = r, r_FC = r_ref, diff, p_spin, q_spin, p_variogram)
C_tab %>% mutate(syndrome = syn_lab(syndrome)) %>% arrange(syndrome, model) %>% mutate(across(where(is.numeric), ~ round(.x, 3)))
dSF %>% mutate(syndrome = syn_lab(syndrome)) %>% arrange(syndrome) %>% mutate(across(where(is.numeric), ~ round(.x, 3)))
```

The rewiring nulls apply only to the SC (FC is a dense correlation matrix). The
FDR for C uses the 7 syndromes × 2 matrices.

```{r C-scatter, fig.height = 5.4}
nb <- do.call(rbind, lapply(primary, function(s) rbind(
  data.frame(syndrome = s, matrix = "SC neighbours", a = d4$A[, s], N = predict_from_model(d4$SC, d4$A[, s])),
  data.frame(syndrome = s, matrix = "FC neighbours", a = d4$A[, s], N = predict_from_model(d4$FC, d4$A[, s])))))
nb$syndrome <- factor(nb$syndrome, primary)
ggplot(nb, aes(N, a)) + geom_point(colour = col_main, alpha = 0.45, size = 1.1) +
  geom_smooth(method = "lm", se = FALSE, colour = "#52514e", linewidth = 0.6) +
  facet_grid(matrix ~ syndrome, scales = "free") +
  labs(x = "Neighbour atrophy N_i", y = "Node atrophy a_i")
```

# D. Epicentres

```{r D-epicentres}
ep <- epicentre_table(d4, c4)
flipN <- c4$flipped
ep_flip <- do.call(rbind, lapply(syn, function(s) { a <- flipN[, s]; sc <- epicentre_score(a, predict_from_model(d4$SC, a)); data.frame(syndrome = s, parcel = seq_along(a), rank_mirrored = rank(-sc, ties.method = "min")) }))
ep_fc <- epicentre_table(d4, list(perms = c4$perms), W = d4$FC) %>% select(syndrome, parcel, rank_FC = rank)
ep <- ep %>% left_join(ep_flip, by = c("syndrome", "parcel")) %>% left_join(ep_fc, by = c("syndrome", "parcel"))
top_ep <- ep %>% filter(rank <= 10) %>% arrange(syndrome_order = match(syndrome, syn), rank) %>%
  transmute(syndrome, rank, parcel = short_label(label), atrophy = round(atrophy, 3), neighbour = round(neighbour, 3),
            p_spin = fmt_p(p_spin), p_rewire = fmt_p(p_rew_deg), rank_FC, rank_mirrored)
top_ep %>% filter(syndrome %in% primary)
```

`rank_mirrored` is the parcel's epicentre rank when the voxel map is mirrored left–right
before parcellation (so a left parcel then samples right-hemisphere data). An epicentre
that keeps its rank under mirroring is not specific to its hemisphere; see Section 9.6.

```{r D-insula}
ins <- ep %>% filter(syndrome == "bvFTD", grepl("FrOperIns|PFCv|Ins", label)) %>% arrange(rank) %>%
  transmute(parcel = short_label(label), rank, p_spin = fmt_p(p_spin), p_rewire = fmt_p(p_rew_deg), rank_mirrored) %>% head(8)
ins
```

# E. Communication models on the SC

```{r E-table}
E_models <- c("SC_direct", "SPE", "communicability", "search_prob", "navigation", "diffusion", "heat", "distance")
E_tab <- mt4 %>% filter(R == 0, model %in% E_models) %>%
  mutate(syndrome = syn_lab(syndrome), model = factor(model, E_models)) %>% arrange(syndrome, model)
E_tab %>% select(syndrome, model, r, param, p_spin, q_spin, p_rew_deg, q_rew_deg, p_rew_geo) %>%
  mutate(param = ifelse(model %in% c("distance", "heat"), signif(param, 3), NA)) %>%
  mutate(across(c(r, p_spin, q_spin, p_rew_deg, q_rew_deg, p_rew_geo), ~ round(.x, 3)))
```

`param` is the fitted λ (mm) for the distance kernel and β for the heat kernel. FDR
covers the 7 tested SC/distance models (SPE, communicability, search information,
navigation, diffusion, heat kernel, distance) × 7 syndromes.

```{r E-plot, fig.height = 6.2, fig.width = 9}
spin_band <- c4$spin %>% filter(R == 0, model %in% E_models) %>% group_by(model, syndrome) %>%
  summarise(lo = quantile(r, 0.025, na.rm = TRUE), hi = quantile(r, 0.975, na.rm = TRUE), .groups = "drop")
pe <- E_tab %>% mutate(model = as.character(model), syndrome = as.character(syndrome)) %>% left_join(spin_band, by = c("model", "syndrome")) %>%
  mutate(model = factor(model_labels[model], rev(model_labels[E_models])), syndrome = syn_lab(syndrome),
         sig = ifelse(q_spin < 0.05, "spin q < 0.05", "n.s."))
ggplot(pe, aes(r, model)) +
  geom_vline(xintercept = 0, colour = "#a8a79f", linewidth = 0.3) +
  geom_errorbarh(aes(xmin = lo, xmax = hi), height = 0, colour = "#c3c2b7", linewidth = 2.2) +
  geom_point(aes(shape = sig), colour = col_main, fill = "#fcfcfb", size = 2.3, stroke = 0.9) +
  scale_shape_manual(values = c("spin q < 0.05" = 16, "n.s." = 21), name = NULL) +
  facet_wrap(~syndrome, ncol = 4) +
  labs(x = "r(atrophy, model-predicted atrophy)", y = NULL, subtitle = "Grey bar: central 95% of the spin null (parameters refitted). Schaefer-400.") +
  theme(legend.position = "bottom")
```

**Does any model beat the distance-only baseline?** Paired difference r_model − r_distance;
two-sided spin p of the difference (both refitted in each spin); FDR across 7 models × 7
syndromes.

```{r E-vs-distance}
vsD <- difference_table(c4, ref = "distance", models = setdiff(E_models, "distance")) %>% filter(R == 0) %>%
  mutate(syndrome = syn_lab(syndrome), model = factor(model, E_models)) %>% arrange(syndrome, desc(diff))
vsD %>% select(syndrome, model, r, r_distance = r_ref, diff, p_spin, q_spin, p_variogram, q_variogram) %>%
  mutate(across(where(is.numeric), ~ round(.x, 3)))
best_by_syn <- E_tab %>% filter(model != "distance") %>% group_by(syndrome) %>% slice_max(r, n = 1) %>% select(syndrome, best_model = model, r)
best_by_syn
```

**Sensitivity: one fitted exponent for every communication model (M^γ).** This gives the
communication models the same single free parameter the distance kernel has.

```{r E-tuned}
tuned <- difference_table(c4, ref = "distance", models = paste0(model_names, "_tuned")) %>% filter(R == 0) %>%
  mutate(syndrome = syn_lab(syndrome)) %>% arrange(syndrome, desc(diff))
tuned %>% select(syndrome, model, r, r_distance = r_ref, diff, p_spin, q_spin) %>% mutate(across(where(is.numeric), ~ round(.x, 3)))
```

# Extensions (less-applied methods)

## Distance-censored prediction

Local spatial smoothness alone can produce a high r(a, P), because neighbouring parcels
have similar atrophy whether or not they are connected. Here each model may only use
parcels further than R mm from the target (R = 0–60 mm), so the prediction has to come
from distant regions. This removes most of the advantage of any purely local kernel,
including the distance baseline, and asks which models still predict atrophy from
long-range relationships. The spin null is recomputed at every radius.

```{r X-censor, fig.height = 6.4, fig.width = 9}
cens_models <- c("SC_direct", "communicability", "search_prob", "navigation", "heat", "distance", "FC")
cz <- mt4 %>% filter(model %in% cens_models, syndrome %in% primary) %>%
  mutate(model = factor(model_labels[model], model_labels[cens_models]), syndrome = factor(syndrome, primary))
cz_band <- c4$spin %>% filter(model == "distance", syndrome %in% primary) %>% group_by(R, syndrome) %>%
  summarise(hi = quantile(r, 0.95, na.rm = TRUE), .groups = "drop") %>% mutate(syndrome = factor(syndrome, primary))
cat_cols <- c("#2a78d6", "#eb6834", "#1baf7a", "#eda100", "#e87ba4", "#52514e", "#6250d6")
ggplot(cz, aes(R, r, colour = model)) +
  geom_hline(yintercept = 0, colour = "#a8a79f", linewidth = 0.3) +
  geom_line(linewidth = 0.8) + geom_point(size = 1.6) +
  geom_line(data = cz_band, aes(R, hi), inherit.aes = FALSE, linetype = 2, colour = "#52514e", linewidth = 0.4) +
  scale_colour_manual(values = setNames(cat_cols, model_labels[cens_models]), name = NULL) +
  facet_wrap(~syndrome, ncol = 4) +
  labs(x = "Exclusion radius R (mm): only parcels further than R are used", y = "r(atrophy, prediction)",
       subtitle = "Dashed: 95th percentile of the spin null for the distance kernel") +
  theme(legend.position = "bottom") + guides(colour = guide_legend(nrow = 2))
cz_tab <- mt4 %>% filter(R == 30, model %in% cens_models) %>% select(syndrome, model, r, p_spin, q_spin, p_rew_deg, p_rew_geo) %>%
  mutate(syndrome = syn_lab(syndrome)) %>% arrange(syndrome, desc(r))
cz_tab %>% mutate(across(where(is.numeric), ~ round(.x, 3)))
vsD30 <- difference_table(c4, ref = "distance", models = c("SC_direct", "communicability", "search_prob", "navigation", "heat", "FC")) %>% filter(R == 30)
vsD30 %>% select(syndrome, model, r, r_distance = r_ref, diff, p_spin, q_spin) %>% mutate(syndrome = syn_lab(syndrome)) %>% arrange(syndrome, desc(diff)) %>% mutate(across(where(is.numeric), ~ round(.x, 3)))
```

At R = 30 mm the SC-direct model drops nodes that have no SC edge longer than 30 mm
(`r unique(mt4$param[mt4$R == 30 & mt4$model == "SC_direct"])` of 400 at Schaefer-400).

## Unique contribution beyond distance

Partial correlation r(a, P_M | P_distance), with the distance kernel refitted for every
map and spin surrogate (null: 1,000 spins).

```{r X-partial}
pm <- c("SC_direct", "communicability", "search_prob", "navigation", "FC")
Mlist <- c(communication_models(d4$SC, d4$Dist)[setdiff(pm, "FC")], list(FC = d4$FC))
As4 <- do.call(cbind, lapply(syn, function(s) spin_maps(d4$A[, s], c4$perms)))
part <- do.call(rbind, lapply(c(0, 30), function(R) do.call(rbind, lapply(pm, function(m) {
  obs <- partial_beyond_distance(Mlist[[m]], d4$A, d4$Dist, R)
  nul <- matrix(partial_beyond_distance(Mlist[[m]], As4, d4$Dist, R), ncol = length(syn))
  data.frame(R = R, model = m, syndrome = syn, partial_r = obs,
             p_spin = sapply(seq_along(syn), function(i) p_upper(obs[i], nul[, i])))
}))))
part$q_spin <- ave(part$p_spin, part$R, FUN = function(p) p.adjust(p, "BH"))
part %>% mutate(syndrome = syn_lab(syndrome)) %>% arrange(R, syndrome, desc(partial_r)) %>% mutate(across(where(is.numeric), ~ round(.x, 3)))
```

## Comparing null models

The same tests under five nulls. Spatial nulls (spin, variogram-matched, Moran)
preserve the map's spatial autocorrelation; rewiring nulls keep the map and replace the
SC by degree-preserving or degree-and-geometry-preserving surrogates.

```{r X-nulls, fig.height = 5.8, fig.width = 9}
nl_models <- c("SC_direct", "communicability", "search_prob", "navigation", "heat", "distance")
nl <- mt4 %>% filter(R %in% c(0, 30), model %in% nl_models) %>%
  select(R, model, syndrome, p_spin, p_variogram, p_moran, p_rew_deg, p_rew_geo) %>%
  pivot_longer(starts_with("p_"), names_to = "null", values_to = "p") %>%
  mutate(null = factor(recode(null, p_spin = "Spin", p_variogram = "Variogram", p_moran = "Moran",
                              p_rew_deg = "Rewired (degree)", p_rew_geo = "Rewired (degree + geometry)"),
                       c("Spin", "Variogram", "Moran", "Rewired (degree)", "Rewired (degree + geometry)")),
         model = factor(model_labels[model], model_labels[nl_models]), Rl = paste0("R = ", R, " mm"))
ggplot(nl %>% filter(!is.na(p)), aes(-log10(p), model, colour = null)) +
  geom_vline(xintercept = -log10(0.05), linetype = 2, colour = "#52514e", linewidth = 0.4) +
  geom_point(position = position_dodge(width = 0.6), size = 1.5) +
  scale_colour_manual(values = setNames(cat_cols[1:5], levels(nl$null)), name = NULL) +
  facet_grid(Rl ~ syndrome) +
  labs(x = "-log10 p (one-sided); dashed line p = 0.05. Maximum = 3 (1,000 surrogates)", y = NULL) +
  theme(legend.position = "bottom", axis.text.x = element_text(size = 7))
nl %>% filter(!is.na(p)) %>% group_by(R, null) %>% summarise(tests = n(), significant_p05 = sum(p < 0.05), median_p = median(p), .groups = "drop")
```

## Geometric vs connectome eigenmodes

Each atrophy map is reconstructed from the first K eigenmodes of three bases:
Laplace–Beltrami eigenmodes of the cortical surface (geometric, Pang et al. 2023;
fsaverage5, medial wall removed, averaged within parcels), eigenvectors of the
normalised SC Laplacian (connectome harmonics), and of the FC Laplacian. Accuracy =
r(a, â_K) by least squares; null: 1,000 spun maps reconstructed with the same basis.

```{r X-eigen, fig.height = 5.4, fig.width = 9}
eig_K <- c(2, 5, 10, 20, 30, 50, 75, 100, 150, 200)
bases <- list(Geometric = geometric_basis(400), `SC harmonics` = laplacian_modes(d4$SC)$vectors, `FC harmonics` = laplacian_modes(d4$FC)$vectors)
eg <- do.call(rbind, lapply(names(bases), function(b) {
  o <- recon_curve(bases[[b]], d4$A, eig_K)
  nl_ <- recon_curve(bases[[b]], As4, eig_K)
  do.call(rbind, lapply(seq_along(syn), function(i) {
    cols <- (i - 1) * ncol(c4$perms) + seq_len(ncol(c4$perms))
    data.frame(basis = b, syndrome = syn[i], K = eig_K, r = o[i, ],
               null_hi = apply(nl_[cols, ], 2, quantile, 0.95), p_spin = sapply(seq_along(eig_K), function(k) p_upper(o[i, k], nl_[cols, k])))
  }))
}))
ggplot(eg %>% filter(syndrome %in% primary) %>% mutate(syndrome = factor(syndrome, primary)), aes(K, r, colour = basis)) +
  geom_line(aes(y = null_hi), linetype = 2, linewidth = 0.4) +
  geom_line(linewidth = 0.8) + geom_point(size = 1.4) +
  scale_x_log10() + scale_colour_manual(values = setNames(cat_cols[c(1, 2, 3)], names(bases)), name = NULL) +
  facet_wrap(~syndrome, ncol = 4) +
  labs(x = "Number of modes K (log scale)", y = "Reconstruction accuracy r", subtitle = "Dashed: 95th percentile of the spin null for the same basis") +
  theme(legend.position = "bottom")
eg %>% filter(K %in% c(10, 20, 50)) %>% select(basis, syndrome, K, r, p_spin) %>%
  pivot_wider(names_from = basis, values_from = c(r, p_spin)) %>% mutate(syndrome = syn_lab(syndrome)) %>% arrange(K, syndrome) %>%
  mutate(across(where(is.numeric), ~ round(.x, 3)))
```

Rewiring null for the connectome harmonics (accuracy with the harmonics of rewired SCs):

```{r X-eigen-rewire}
rec_obs <- recon_curve(laplacian_modes(d4$SC)$vectors, d4$A, harmonic_Ks)
rr <- do.call(rbind, lapply(c("rew_deg", "rew_geo"), function(nm) {
  x <- c4[[nm]]$recon # syndromes x K x B
  do.call(rbind, lapply(seq_along(syn), function(i) data.frame(null = nm, syndrome = syn[i], K = harmonic_Ks, r_obs = rec_obs[i, ],
    null_median = apply(x[i, , ], 1, median), p = sapply(seq_along(harmonic_Ks), function(k) p_upper(rec_obs[i, k], x[i, k, ]))))
}))
rr %>% filter(K %in% c(10, 20, 50)) %>% mutate(syndrome = syn_lab(syndrome)) %>% arrange(null, K, syndrome) %>% mutate(across(where(is.numeric), ~ round(.x, 3)))
```

## Smoothness of atrophy on the SC

Normalised Dirichlet energy aᵀLa / aᵀa of the z-scored map on the SC graph (lower = atrophy
varies less across strong connections).

```{r X-smooth}
sm_obs <- graph_smoothness(d4$SC, d4$A)
sm_spin <- matrix(graph_smoothness(d4$SC, As4), ncol = length(syn))
sm <- data.frame(syndrome = syn, energy = sm_obs,
                 p_spin = sapply(seq_along(syn), function(i) (1 + sum(sm_spin[, i] <= sm_obs[i])) / (1 + nrow(sm_spin))),
                 p_rew_deg = sapply(seq_along(syn), function(i) (1 + sum(c4$rew_deg$smooth[i, ] <= sm_obs[i])) / (1 + ncol(c4$rew_deg$smooth))),
                 p_rew_geo = sapply(seq_along(syn), function(i) (1 + sum(c4$rew_geo$smooth[i, ] <= sm_obs[i])) / (1 + ncol(c4$rew_geo$smooth))))
sm %>% mutate(across(where(is.numeric), ~ round(.x, 3)))
```

## Laterality and the atlas

```{r X-laterality}
lat <- voxel_laterality(400)
flip_r <- sapply(syn, function(s) cor(d4$A[, s], c4$flipped[, s]))
hemi_diff <- function(a, info) mean(a[info$hemi == "LH"]) - mean(a[info$hemi == "RH"])
lat$parcel_LminusR <- sapply(syn, function(s) hemi_diff(d4$A[, s], d4$info))
lat$parcel_LminusR_mirrored <- sapply(syn, function(s) hemi_diff(c4$flipped[, s], d4$info))
lat$r_original_vs_mirrored_parcels <- flip_r
lat %>% mutate(across(where(is.numeric), ~ round(.x, 3)))
```

## Robustness across resolutions

```{r X-resolution}
rob <- do.call(rbind, lapply(names(CC), function(k) {
  mt <- model_table(CC[[k]])
  x <- mt %>% filter(R == 0, model %in% c("SC_direct", "FC", "distance", "heat", "communicability", "search_prob")) %>% select(model, syndrome, r, q_spin, q_rew_deg)
  x$parcels <- as.integer(k); x
}))
rob %>% select(parcels, syndrome, model, r) %>% pivot_wider(names_from = parcels, values_from = r, names_prefix = "r_") %>%
  mutate(syndrome = syn_lab(syndrome)) %>% arrange(syndrome, model) %>% mutate(across(where(is.numeric), ~ round(.x, 3)))
rob_vsD <- do.call(rbind, lapply(names(CC), function(k) {
  x <- difference_table(CC[[k]], ref = "distance", models = setdiff(E_models, "distance"), nulls = "spin") %>% filter(R %in% c(0, 30))
  x$parcels <- as.integer(k); x
}))
rob_vsD %>% group_by(parcels, R) %>% summarise(tests = n(), model_better_q05 = sum(diff > 0 & q_spin < 0.05), model_worse_q05 = sum(diff < 0 & q_spin < 0.05), .groups = "drop")
```
